summary.text: Brian Turner is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 116 in Buncombe County who assumed office on January 1, 2025, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists earlier service in the same district from 2015 to 2023, and the General Assembly lists his occupation as real estate.

paragraphs.text: Turner grew up in Asheville, North Carolina, according to Ballotpedia.
He received a bachelor's degree in economics from Northwestern University and a master's degree in business administration from Wake Forest University.
His career included work as a sewing machine operator and a television producer, and he served on the leadership team of his family business, Mills Manufacturing.
Turner joined UNC Asheville as Director of Corporate and Foundation Relations in 2012 and later served as an assistant vice chancellor.

Turner serves on the House Alcoholic Beverage Control, Appropriations, Higher Education, Emergency Management and Disaster Recovery, and Wildlife Resources committees, along with the House Select Committees on Helene Recovery and on Property Tax Reduction and Reform.
